title: Heddle — Handloom Draft Studio
description: Write a weaving draft the way weavers do — threading, tie-up, treadling — and watch the cloth solve itself underneath.
concept: Heddle is a four-block weaving draft editor. You paint the threading (which warp end rides which shaft), toggle the tie-up (which shafts each treadle lifts) and set the treadling order; the drawdown below solves the interlacement live and renders it in real yarn colours. Switch to Cloth for a lit, shaded weave you can zoom into, or to Loom to watch a shuttle fly through the shed pick by pick while the fabric runs away under the fell. Eleven classic structures ship in the library, from tabby to goose eye to waffle, and the float counter tells you whether your cloth would actually hold together.
features: Three modes — editable draft, lit woven-cloth render, and an animated loom with a real shed and flying shuttle
Eleven weave presets (tabby, basket, 2/2 and 3/1 twill, herringbone, goose eye, rosepath, waffle, satin, undulating, M's & O's) that re-derive correctly for 4 or 8 shafts
Drag-paint threading, treadling and warp/weft colour strips; tap the tie-up to toggle a shaft lift
Yarn tools: 7 palettes plus stripe, tartan, log cabin, gradient, shuffle and solid sequence generators targeting warp, weft or both
Live structure analysis — longest warp and weft float, warp/weft balance and repeat size, flagged when floats get too long to weave
Export the cloth as a captioned PNG, the draft as JSON, or copy a share link that packs the whole draft into the URL
localStorage autosave restores your loom exactly as you left it

interaction.mouse: Drag across the threading grid to assign ends to shafts; drag the treadling column to set the pick order; drag the top and left strips to paint warp and weft colours.
interaction.click: Click the tie-up block to toggle which shafts a treadle lifts; click the drawdown to pick up that pick's yarn colour; in Cloth mode click to cycle the yarn size.
interaction.touch: Every grid and strip is drag-paintable with one finger; the canvas sets touch-action:none so painting never scrolls the page.
interaction.keyboard: 1/2/3 switch Draft, Cloth and Loom · space plays or pauses the loom · e exports a PNG · r reweaves at random · [ and ] change yarn size.
